set.body: After copy, elementwise, and reduction work lands, rerun the full side 256 and 1024 JDK 21 versus pinned NumPy suite with two forks, GC profiling, signatures, and same-host controls. Acceptance: compute geomean at least 0.50x NumPy, no compute case below 0.25x unless an exact-schedule lower-bound receipt proves a documented numerical-contract tax, no same-host case regresses more than 10 percent, JVM and Scala.js full gates pass, built-in primitive loops remain monomorphic and callback-free, and stable-runner nightly thresholds plus updated checked-in baselines are documented. If targets fail, open a measured residual-gap decision before considering SIMD, parallelism, native code, or a new public reduction policy.
set.title: Ratify performance closeout and regression gates
